title: Technical-manager existing-rail execution audit
purpose: Determine whether the existing Jiangsu/Xuzhou technical-manager system is merely an institutional ecosystem or a genuinely enterable contract/invoice/commission rail for an external project-based operator with self-sourced qualified projects.

facts.fact: The 2026 Jiangsu Technical Manager Office rules explicitly allow offices to recruit technical managers from society and establish affiliation relationships through project cooperation or similar arrangements, with a standardized agreement.
The same rule explicitly permits offices and affiliated technical managers to settle technology-transfer service commissions according to their agreement.
The office is explicitly expected to provide technology-transaction service contract signing, invoicing and settlement support to affiliated technical managers.

Offices are expected to organize or work with technical managers on enterprise demand diagnosis, research-team/result matching, incubation, maturation, promotion and transactions, and may lawfully obtain service income.

Professional/social technical managers are encouraged to create partnership or OPC operating entities and may apply to establish a market-oriented technical-manager office without being bound by the ordinary Article 5 scale/history conditions.

Current 2026 Jiangsu technical-manager training still uses the 'two-way selection / affiliation' mechanism with technical-manager offices as the practical route for participants to establish cooperation and perform real project work.

The latest directly indexed official registration guide found in public search describes account registration, real-name verification and technical-manager identity application, and describes office affiliation as voluntary and based on bilateral selection plus an affiliation agreement. This guide is from 2024 and is supporting continuity evidence, not a substitute for a 2026 office's current intake terms.

The national 2026 Technology Contract Recognition and Registration rules recognize technology intermediary contracts as a type of technology service contract; technology contract registration is voluntary and can support policy treatment when conditions are met.

public_truth: Current 2026 office rules do not publish a universal rule that every externally affiliated/project-cooperation technical manager must already hold one specific certificate before an office may cooperate.
The rule does require offices to recruit 'outstanding technical managers' lawfully and use standardized agreements.
Current training and archived registration materials show platform registration, training and office affiliation as the normal professionalization path.
unknowns: Whether a specific Xuzhou office requires a training certificate before accepting a project-based affiliate.
Whether platform technical-manager registration can currently be completed before office affiliation in the Xuzhou flow.
Whether an existing professional background plus a self-sourced qualified project can substitute for prior technical-transfer track record at a target office.

public_truth: Ordinary market-oriented office applicants face Article 5 requirements on Jiangsu registration, office location, staff, operating history/revenue and past transfer results.

Article 6 creates an exceptional route for professional/social technical managers who establish a partnership or OPC operating entity; such applicants may apply for market-oriented office status without Article 5 conditions.
office_creation_route.interpretation: Creating a new office is legally/institutionally possible but is not the lowest-friction first test. Existing-office project cooperation is the shorter route to external value flow.

proven: An office may lawfully obtain service income.
An office may sign the technology-transaction service contract.
An office may issue invoices and conduct settlement.
An office may settle service commission with an affiliated technical manager according to their agreement.
not_publicly_bound: No current 2026 public rule found specifies one mandatory commission percentage for the technical manager.
No current 2026 public rule found specifies one mandatory office service-fee percentage.
No current 2026 public rule found specifies one universal split for multiple technical managers on the same project.
No public rule found establishes that a self-sourced project must be accepted by an office.
No public rule found establishes a universal milestone that triggers the affiliate's commission payment.
No public rule found establishes who bears refund, dispute, IP, performance or failed-match liability in every office arrangement.
money_flow_map.historical_rate_handling: Older historical materials contain suggested fee/split conventions, but Scan 028 does not treat those figures as current truth because the 2026 governing rule uses 'by agreement' and does not reproduce a fixed rate.

xuzhou_entry_points.office_or_platform: China University of Mining and Technology National University Science Park
xuzhou_entry_points.role: recognized Jiangsu technical-manager office / technology-transfer and science-park platform
xuzhou_entry_points.current_activity_evidence: The park publicly shows a 2026 initial technical-manager training event and maintains a dedicated Science & Technology Services Department responsible for R&D, concept validation, testing, technical consultation and technology transfer.
xuzhou_entry_points.reason: Local, currently active, explicitly handles technology transfer, and historically stated it would absorb/collaborate with technical managers.

xuzhou_entry_points.office_or_platform: Xuzhou Medical University Asset Management Co., Ltd.
xuzhou_entry_points.current_activity_evidence: Approved in 2026; publicly reports an 18-person technical-manager team, 1000+ patents listed and medical/health concept-validation infrastructure.
xuzhou_entry_points.reason: Strong current institutional proof, but its biomedical/health focus may make it less suitable for a general first-route probe.

xuzhou_entry_points.office_or_platform: Xuzhou Zhongyan Meihui Information Technology Co., Ltd.
xuzhou_entry_points.role: market-oriented Jiangsu technical-manager office appearing in current Xuzhou High-tech Zone technology-transfer activities
xuzhou_entry_points.current_activity_evidence: Participated as a technical-manager office in current local university-enterprise matching activities.
xuzhou_entry_points.reason: Potentially closer to a market-oriented operating model, but Scan 028 did not find a sufficiently authoritative current public page with exact affiliate intake/settlement contacts and terms.

decision.rationale: Policy evidence now proves the existence of a project-cooperation affiliation and contract/invoice/commission rail. Remaining uncertainty is no longer whether such a rail exists; it is office-specific access, qualification, economics and settlement terms. Those cannot be truthfully resolved by further generic web search.

bounded_human_probe.preferred_target: China University of Mining and Technology National University Science Park - Science & Technology Services Department
bounded_human_probe.objective: Verify whether an external project-based technical manager who can bring a self-sourced qualified enterprise technology demand/project may establish a project-cooperation/affiliation relationship and participate in service-commission settlement.
questions: Do you currently accept external/social technical managers through project cooperation or affiliation?
If I bring a real self-sourced enterprise technical demand/project, may I first submit the project for review before completing full affiliation?
What individual qualifications or training/registration are mandatory before project cooperation?
Is Jiangsu technical-manager platform registration required before signing the affiliation/project-cooperation agreement?
Who signs the service contract with the enterprise or technology owner: the office, the technical manager, or another entity?
Who issues the invoice and receives customer payment?
How is the technical manager's commission defined: fixed percentage, case-by-case agreement, or project-specific schedule?
What event triggers commission settlement: service-fee receipt, technology-contract registration, technical transaction payment, project acceptance, or another milestone?
If I independently source both the enterprise demand and the solution/result, does the office accept such a project and how is attribution recorded?
Are there any restrictions on industry, geography, deal size, exclusivity, confidentiality, IP handling or liability that would prevent this model?
bounded_human_probe.stop_rule: One qualified office response that answers access + mandatory qualification + contract/invoice controller + commission basis + settlement trigger is enough to promote or kill the immediate route. Do not spray outreach across many offices.

next_action: Await explicit authorization for the single bounded human probe. If authorized, contact only the preferred target first and persist the exact response before any second outreach.
